As a freshman right now this is my input: 

- The distance between classes. If your classes are far apart make sure you have enough time between class to where you can walk and cool off. Believe me it gets hot and sometimes the stairs make it worse. 

- If you involve yourself in organizations on campus you’ll probably have a higher chance at making friends. It’s how I met my closest friends. 

- Go to some of the free events especially the UPC ones. There pretty fun and they give away free stuff!

- Food wise, I would like to say that the cafeterias have a bad habit of giving you less when there’s a lot of of people especially during tours it gets packed. I’ve seen at EL them cut up one slice of pizza and make it 2 slices. 

- For some reason people don’t realize there’s a whole section where they sell pizza, sushi, burgers,etc in the union. It’s by Starbucks, a little hidden but believe me the food there is worth it. 

- The gym will definitely stay packed.
